cases.prompt: A Literature workflow has an approved reader-owned proposition with origin paths. Record it `/using-slipbox`.
cases.expected_output: Routes to the Record an Evergreen candidate action, requires proposition, reason, origin kind and origin paths, and does not reinterpret the proposition. The caller uses the natural imperative action followed by `/using-slipbox`.

cases.prompt: A specialist has assembled a complete note draft. Publish the artifact `/using-slipbox`.
cases.expected_output: Routes to Publish an artifact, runs /write-checks before any write, and uses the CLI only for the transaction. The caller uses the natural imperative action followed by `/using-slipbox`.

cases.prompt: Record a link between two notes, then inspect source analysis `/using-slipbox`.
cases.expected_output: Routes to Record a link and Inspect source analysis; exact CLI flags are obtained from the relevant reference rather than repeated in each action. The caller uses the natural imperative action followed by `/using-slipbox`.

cases.prompt: A Resource workflow needs to start recoverable work, checkpoint it, and publish the approved artifact. Record the work `/using-slipbox`.
cases.expected_output: Uses the natural imperative caller form and routes start, checkpoint, and publish through the shared engine. Work is identified by work_id, remains local under .slipbox/work, and publication runs /write-checks before the CLI transaction.

cases.prompt: A command failed after a source changed. Recover the interrupted Literature work `/using-slipbox`, then inspect the source-map cache.
cases.expected_output: Inspects the work before resuming, compares fingerprints, preserves failed or blocked evidence, and does not claim success when repair is required. Cache reuse is decided from Resource SHA-256 identity and compatibility metadata; cache persistence is independent from local work.

cases.prompt: Prepare Resource, Literature, Reference, Evergreen, and migration work through the shared runtime `/using-slipbox`.
cases.expected_output: Accepts exactly the runtime work kinds resource, literature, reference, evergreen, and migration. Shared work, cache, transaction, tombstone, and Git procedures come from /using-slipbox and the CLI/help references rather than being re-described as specialist workflow.

cases.prompt: Audit the peer callers for shared action vocabulary.
cases.expected_output: Peer callers use Start or resume work, Checkpoint work, Publish an artifact, Record an Evergreen candidate, and Record a link followed by `/using-slipbox`; they do not repeat raw links/evergreen commands, `work finalize`, or phrases such as log tension or route seed.
